ops.title: During phases 1-3, Fleet build red on main is expected and carries no information
ops.body:
As of P1a (commit c87f8a3) the fleet-build CI job on main is RED and stays red until phase 3
closes. This is BY DESIGN (BUILD-ORDER.md): the module is broken-for-consumers during phases 1-3
as the surface is rewritten in place (one flag day). P1a alone removed 12 exported proc.FileLock*
symbols that synckit/cc-orchestrate/cc-interact/reposync consume, so they fail fleet-build with
`undefined: proc.FileLockSpec` etc. -- the intended flag-day compile break.

The PER-COMMIT phase gates during phases 1-3 are the IN-REPO jobs, all of which were GREEN on P1a:
CI (go build/vet/-race/test/lint), Mixed era, Export census, Docs drift, Guides. Fleet build (and
the signed-peer E2E, which can't run until the module compiles) are RELEASE gates, deferred to
phase 3+. Standing rule "fleet-build red = no release" still holds -- it gates RELEASES, not these
broken-by-design phase commits. Do NOT fix-forward or triage the fleet-build redness during phases
1-3; it resolves when phase 3 restores a compiling module and the consumers repin at the phase-4
flag day. Reference: note d9b94fb (G1), 0592653 (phase-1 coordination), BUILD-ORDER.md.
